author: Yffe
content:
Failing test at forge/tests/divergence_strings.rs::divergence_join_l3_not_mutation_gated_l0 (#[ignore = "blocker #80"]) pins the divergence.

LIVE: `forge check conformance/string_demo.th --json`:
  greeting_len -> L3 pure (1/1) OK
  first_byte   -> L3 pure (2/2) OK
  join         -> L0 WeakContract, mutants_killed 0/0  <-- DIVERGENCE
  literal_len  -> L3 alloc (1/1) OK

ORACLE conformance/string/cases.json: join -> L3, effects [alloc]. Golden tests/golden/lower/string_demo.verus.rs verifies 11 verified, 0 errors, so the verus proof SUCCEEDS — the L0 is purely the mutation-gate.

ROOT CAUSE (the #74 Type::Vec gap, recurring for Type::String): forge/src/mutation.rs early_return_value(f) handles Type::Vec (#74 empty-TVec synthesis) and Type::Ref-of-Slice (#48 empty &[]) but has NO Type::String arm, and zero_value_for(&Type) has no String case. join's body `a.concat(b)` has no binop/off-by-one/branch site, so generate() yields ZERO mutants -> MutationScore 0/0 -> kill_ratio 0.0 -> #48 anti-Goodhart backstop -> Certificate::rejected_weak_contract -> Level::L0.

FIX DIRECTION (for the fixer, NOT done here): add a Type::String arm to early_return_value mirroring empty_vec_value — synthesize an empty TString early-return `TString { data: Vec::new() }` (len 0). join's `ens result.len() == a.len()+b.len()` REJECTS the empty TString (0 != a+b unless both empty) -> the mutant is KILLED -> join scores the floor and certifies L3.

Why the existing suite (506 green) missed it: thermite-lower/tests/string_conformance.rs exercises whole-program lower + direct verus + raw cases.json text, never the per-item forge::check::check_file ladder that runs mutation scoring. Same blind spot as #68/#74.
